_comment: Quick enrollment for testing/demo. Run: ContAuth.exe --config agent-config.fast.json

_notes.speed: 4 windows x 2 s = ~8 s to enroll; 30 s warm-up.
_notes.tradeoff: A profile from ~8 s of activity is weak — great for a demo, but it will misfire more in real daily use. For real protection prefer agent-config.example.json (20 windows).
_notes.dry_run: set true to log 'would lock' instead of locking while you test.
